type.description: OpenAI's error family: invalid_request_error, authentication_error, permission_error, not_found_error, conflict_error, server_error.

code.description: The harness's reason: unauthorized, forbidden, model_not_found, run_active, unavailable.

param.description: The request field at fault, when one is.

error.description: What went wrong, as OpenAI shapes it.

agent-harness.description: The session and run a failed turn ran on, when it got that far.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

reason.description: Why a run ended: completed, error, interrupted (with its cause), disposed (the environment let the run go: its session was deleted, or the environment closed), drained (cut by a drain's cap).

anyOf.description: What interrupted a run: user (runs.interrupt), read-now, restart (the recovery sweep after a restart), parked (its process was stopped while parked on a prompt), timeout (a routine's firing ran past its maximum duration).

ended.description: How the run ended: its run.ended reason and, for an interrupted one, the cause.
